Recommended High-Signal Videos to Watch:
1. [Gita Gopinath (IMF) on Raj Shamani]: How Money Is Created, Central Banks & Inflation (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dNIef2fGLQY)
   - Macro deep dive into fractional reserve banking, money supply, de-dollarization, and currency debasement.
2. [Paul Graham & Amjad Masad (YC)]: How To Build The Future (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q78dJ0vkWe8)
   - Autonomous AI software engineering, commoditization of syntax, where startup moats actually lie.
3. [Zerodha Back Office Ep 5]: Inside Zerodha’s Tech Team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4OqXCbcv5BA)
   - 35 engineers, zero PMs, no Agile overhead, self-hosted open source powering 15%+ of NSE retail volume.
4. [Think School]: 50-Min Bond Masterclass (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjxaqZmvVPA)
   - Corporate bonds, G-Secs, and debt yields for retail investors; locking in 9-10%+ before rate cuts.
5. [Ankur Warikoo]: 1 Lakh Gold Selling Reality (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7ddps0EfIgg)
   - Jewellery math breakdown: 3% GST + 15-25% making charges + resale deductions = ~₹75k recovery.
6. [Day Trader Telugu]: Market Rally vs Portfolio Crash (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wuJ1ARZ5bEQ)
   - FII short-covering in large caps vs mid/small-cap bleed; Angel One taking 15% NSE market share over Zerodha.
7. [Think School]: Real Estate Psychology (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7R747kVWvZY)
   - Hidden registration, stamp duty, maintenance friction vs true index fund compounding.
8. [Zerodha Coin]: Micro-Savings from ₹10 (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HvKjxUSxqx0)
   - Daily automated micro-SIPs for college students & freshers.

Study & Content Focus:
- Comprehensive breakdown: What every salaried individual in India must do after landing their first job (salary slip, EPF/EPS/EDLI, emergency fund, health/term insurance, tax regime, first SIP).

Latest High-Signal Updates (Nov 12-13, 2026):
- Macro: India Oct CPI jumped to 6.09% (2-year high, breaching RBI 6% ceiling). Shuts door on rate cuts, home loan EMIs set to rise.
- Gold & SGB: SGB 2018-19 Series-III reached 8-year final maturity today (Nov 13). ₹3,183/g -> ₹13,700+/g (4.3x gain, 100% tax-free under Sec 47).
- Wedding Gold Math: Quoted 24K vs 22K rate formula, gross-weight making charge inflation (8-25%), 3% GST, and BIS HUID verification.
- EPF vs Home Loan: EPFO Para 68BB allows up to 90% withdrawal for housing, but withdrawing 8.25% sovereign tax-free compounding pool costs ₹85L+ by retirement.
- AMFI Data: 5.9M SIPs stopped in Oct (116% stoppage ratio) as Nifty TRI fell -13.3% YoY. Small-cap inflows fell 29%, large-cap rose 20%.
- Tech & Business: Zupee shuts down / lays off 100% staff due to 28% GST. Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid probe & B AI debt scrutiny (forfeits M equity; Colette Kress interim CEO).
- Long-Form Creator: Kent Yoshimura on Raj Shamani (FO587) on building M D2C/quick-commerce brand; Day Trader Telugu on gold drop & Nifty support.
